listing.name: Might and Magic VII (OpenEnroth)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Official README says MM7 playable; desktop nightly packages available. Limits: MM7 playable upstream; MM6/MM8 planned. Nightly-only releases may contain bugs. Upstream platforms: Nightly Windows x86/x86-64 ZIPs, Linux x86-64 Flatpak, macOS ARM64/x86-64 DMGs and Android universal APK. MM7 current; other MM games remain planned. Original data: MM6 and MM8 only planned; do not list them as playable current targets. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
